title: Define exact unnecessary-check detection semantics
objective: Define a deterministic validation-trace contract and detector that recomputes exact T1/T2/T3/T4 obligations from impact families and risk, flags extra work as overvalidation, flags missing work as undervalidation, and detects repeated stage execution without running validation itself.
non_goals: modify T0 T1 T2 or T3/T4 selection behavior

required_invariants: expected T1 checks are recomputed only from impact families and the canonical T1 policy
expected T2 groups are recomputed only from T1-uncovered impacts and the canonical T2 policy
expected T3/T4 requirements are recomputed only from T2 residual or covered impacts risk class and canonical selector policy
extra selected checks groups requirements stage invocations pytest full-suite network or deep execution are classified as overvalidation
missing required checks groups requirements or pytest execution are classified as undervalidation
detector executes no validation tier subprocess network call or external service
detector distinguishes exact clean validation from overvalidation and undervalidation
acceptance_criteria: documentation-only impact expects zero T1 T2 T3 T4 work for low risk
governance/config impact expects only the T1 checks mapped by policy
workflow/security impacts require their mapped T3 requirements but no execution in incremental validation
risk class changes alter expected T3/T4 requirements exactly through policy
repeated stage invocation is detected as redundant work
pytest without a selected T2 group is detected as unnecessary
synthetic exact trace returns CLEAN and the core is ready for WU02 CI qualification

done_when: exact expected validation work is deterministically derivable from impact families and risk
overvalidation and undervalidation are separate fail-closed findings
core detector is zero-dependency and execution-free
executable integration and adversarial qualification are delegated to ENG-08.2-WU02
